LanguageData.VGE_Exopede.label: exopede
LanguageData.VGE_Exopede.description: A large bioengineered insectoid roughly the size of a deer. The exopede is heavily armored and adapted to survive the frigid vacuum of space, and functions as a middle-caste hive worker, performing most tasks and defending the hive with its powerful appendages. While heavily protected and dangerous in combat, its movement is relatively slow on open ground.
